description.narrative: The aim of this preparatory study is to advance climate change conversations. We wish to start a partnership project with Activista Kenya where we seek to support the education of youth on climate change, with a focus on co-producing knowledge and tools to empower them to use their voice on climate change, with the end game of becoming a ‘Green Ambassador’ in their local communities. The overall project will be divided into two different stages - the first stage will be conducting a training of trainers where they will get knowledge about climate change including tools for advocacy followed by the second stage of contextualised training at their local communities through fun and interactive workshops. Therefore, this preparatory study aims to situate the volunteers into the realities of what the climate impacts are in Kenya, what the norms of volunteering are in Kenya, how we can find the right volunteers to become Green Ambassadors, and to start developing our pilot project.
